insight: Its Android version ships as a standalone browser, Babel Browser, because mobile Chrome doesn't support extensions.
name: Immersive Translate
tagline: Bilingual side-by-side translation for web pages, PDFs, ebooks, and video subtitles.
description: Immersive Translate is a browser extension that renders foreign-language pages bilingually, showing the translation alongside the original text instead of replacing it. It covers web pages, PDFs (including scanned OCR), EPUBs, video subtitles on 100+ platforms, and manga/image translation, and lets you switch between a dozen-plus machine-translation engines and LLMs. The core extension is free; a Pro membership bundles premium engine quota.

modelSupport.notes: A dozen-plus MT engines and LLMs; bring your own API keys or use Pro quota.

edge: Side-by-side bilingual layout across web, PDF, EPUB, and video subtitles, with a dozen-plus swappable engines — broader format coverage than rival sidebars.
pros: Works with your own API keys
cons: Pro needed for bundled DeepL/OpenAI quota
Heavy pages can render translations slowly
Quality depends on the engine you pick
